name: Locale Atlas
author: ct
description: Localization key map for developers and AI agents: every key declared in locale/*.properties or referenced by scenarios, C#, JSON, scenes, collections and manifests, per language. Reports keys that are missing in some languages, empty, undeclared or duplicated, collection texts without a translation, and the encoding of every locale file (UTF-8 validity, BOM, mojibake, control characters, line endings). Activated by the --locale-atlas user arg; writes report.md/report.json and prints [TEST_RESULT].
